references.text: Describes the use of trumpets on feast days and new moon days, including the first day of the seventh month
Parallel text describing the offerings to be brought on the first day of the seventh month, called a day of trumpet blast (תְּרוּעָה)
Introduces the Lord's feasts and holy assemblies (מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ) as context for verse 24
Describes blowing of horns on the tenth day of the seventh month in the year of Jubilee, linked to the same month and use of trumpets
Ezra reads the law on the first day of the seventh month, and the people are reminded that it is a holy day
Mentions blowing of horns at new moon and full moon on the feast day, as a statute for Israel
Describes praise with trumpets and horns to the Lord as King
Mentions the seventh month and the feast lasting seven days, linked to the same calendar period
